subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 10: Quarter Scale Model Task
description: Create a quarter scale drawing or model by applying scale factor, similar polygons, and special triangle measurements.
learningObjectives: Interpret a quarter scale as a scale factor of 1/4 from actual size to model size
Create a scale drawing or model with corresponding lengths multiplied by the same scale factor
Use similar polygons to keep shape, angle measures, and side ratios consistent
Apply 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 triangle relationships to roof, ramp, or support measurements
Organize actual and model measurements in a table
Explain the scale factor and measurement choices used in a final scale model
prerequisites: Multiply and divide decimals and fractions
Recognize corresponding sides and angles in similar polygons
Use proportions to solve missing lengths
Know the side relationships in 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 triangles
Read simple floor plans and labeled geometry diagrams
